image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) resting on a white, textured surface (likely cloth). The crab features a broad, oval-shaped reddish-brown carapace with lighter mottling. It has five pairs of legs extending laterally, with the first pair modified into large claws (chelipeds). The legs appear somewhat pale and yellowish-tan compared to the darker carapace. The eyes are visible as small stalks at the anterior margin.
